description: Performs recursive, deep web research using Gemini's native Interactions API and creates cited documents.

mandatory_attributes.description: The exact subject or question to research.
The desired depth of the report (e.g., 'brief overview', 'comprehensive deep dive', 'executive summary').

optional_attributes.description: Whether to auto-generate charts and graphs.
Who the report is written for (e.g., 'college students', 'board members', 'general public').

output_schema.description: Path to the generated structured .pdf report containing charts.
